answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 29089 Country: India Title: After cutting the hairs of 'sharmgah', Is it necessary to do 'gusl'? And in which cases we have to do 'gusl'? Question: After cutting the hairs of 'sharmgah', Is it necessary to do 'gusl'? And in which cases we have to do 'gusl'? Answer ID: 29089 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 117/98/L=1432) It is not necessary to have ghusl after shaving pubic hair. Ghusl becomes wajib by having intercourse with wife or by discharge of semen with lust etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
